posts.text: Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser costs doubled? Nice photo. Ask a farmer in the north what 'prosperity' looks like. Arden at least said where the jobs would come from. Still waiting on Ostrand's numbers.

Ostrand says the highway is 'a new era of prosperity'. Fine. But inflation's still eating my rent, and nobody's asked her to explain that. Arden at least showed up with a number: 200k jobs. Want to see the costings though.

Watched the debate tonight. Arden talks about 200,000 jobs, but nobody asked how he'd pay for them. Ostrand's inflation numbers still don't match what my grocery bill says. Who's actually checking the math?

Watched the first debate tonight. Ostrand pointed to inflation falling from its peak, which is fair, but she skated past why grocery prices still bite. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing before I take it seriously. Both owe us the numbers. Which of them will actually show their working?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 of 11. Checked VeriCheck's latest: the 'Arden doubles VAT' claim is FALSE, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month, so it's MISLEADING. They also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the full fact-checks before you share anything.
Day 2 and I've already got a headache from two candidates promising 'prosperity' and 'jobs' without a single receipt. Show me the costings or it's all just vibes and ribbon-cutting. #VeloriaVotes

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' number is a peak-month figure. Fair enough. But they also say the plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. That's the number I want Arden to answer for. Anyone seen his response?
Fuel up 40% and fertiliser doubled, and they want five more years? Ask a farmer in the north what the numbers look like at the pump. Show me the receipts, Mara.

Two weeks out and I still can't get a straight answer on what 200,000 jobs cost. Ostrand's numbers don't match my grocery receipts either. Someone please just show the math, both of you. #VeloriaVotes

Read VeriCheck's breakdown of the Arden plan. Good that the VAT claim got rebutted, but a ~2% of GDP gap is not nothing. Mara's record on grocery prices deserves the same scrutiny. Both sides, same standard, please.
Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning, and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Mara actually had numbers in the debate tonight for once. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is running a clip 'questioning' a recording of Arden. Before anyone shares it: has anyone checked where it came from, who first posted it, or whether the Civic Front's denial has been independently verified? Hold off on passing it along until we know more.

A VBC clip 'raising questions' about a recording, and the other side says it's not genuine, with no way to check either. Show me where the recording came from before I form an opinion. Still undecided and still tired. #VeloriaVotes

VBC played the full clip and then said 'questions raised'. Did anyone check who first posted it, and when? Not saying it's fake or real. Just saying I'd like to see provenance before the outrage cycle starts. #VeloriaVotes

Before anyone shares the 'leaked audio': the Civic Front says it's an AI fake, and VBC itself only said 'questions raised' and that the recording is disputed. Check it before forwarding. Verify first, then panic.

posts.text: Hearing the 'we'll pay the commission and our agents will handle the rest' audio everywhere today. Even if it's real, it's worth waiting for the verification before sharing. Anyone seen a fact-check on it yet? #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip in full, twice. Whatever it is, a 'recording' with no source, no date, and no chain of custody isn't evidence of anything yet. Before anyone reacts, ask: who has it, and can the file be verified? Both camps should want that answered.

Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to relax. Read the margin before you panic or celebrate. Two weeks is a long time in a market day. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days out, and the only thing trending is a 'foreign passport' headline with no link to the source doc. Poll says 46-44 with a ±3 margin, so basically a coin flip with ribbon-cutting. Can someone just show me the receipts for ANY of this? #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with a margin of error. Anyone calling this over is reading tea leaves. Still stuck in Kessa traffic btw #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Two things before you share: Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Where's the source for that? Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so it's a statistical tie. Check the primary documents and the poll methodology before you panic or cheer. #VeloriaVotes

Ledger says a deputy finance minister funneled road money to a relative's firm. Ministry says 'fabricated.' Two sides, zero documents in the story I can see. Does anyone have the actual papers, or are we just picking a team? #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin of error ±3. That's a dead heat. Nine days out and I'm still waiting for someone to show the costings for either side's numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Read the Ledger's exclusive on the road funds and the ministry's 'fabricated' reply. Documents with no date stamp and no named signatory are a lead, not a finding. Ask who holds them and whether they can be authenticated. Same bar for every side. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. That's inside the margin of error, so nobody gets to claim a landslide. Ask both camps for their costings before election day, north and south alike. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. VeloResults portal is live for scanned polling-station forms, and the commission is inviting observers to a system test. Before the next 'leaked' clip or 'foreign passport' claim, check whether it has a source and a date. Procedure is where we verify, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, eight days out. Two things worth a second look before you share: a WhatsApp 'ambassador' scheme paying 5,000 vel per polling station that votes Unity, and the Commission's VeloResults portal, where forms will be public. Pay attention to who pays and where the forms are. Anyone can run the system test. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out, and #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs are both trending from accounts made THIS MONTH posting near-identical text. Bots or just a coincidence? Check who's behind the tags before you pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot is paying 5,000 vel per polling station. Nobody pays that to sign up voters for free. Also: the commission is opening VeloResults for observer tests. Go look at the real process before you trust any forwarded screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out and still no receipts from anyone. Before we pick a side, can someone show where the 200k jobs money comes from and why the inflation numbers don't match what I pay at the till? Honest math, please. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Both #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs trending, but researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text. Before you pick a hashtag, check who's pushing it. VeloResults is open to observers, so the forms are checkable. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The commission's VeloResults procedure is worth reading before the vote: forms scanned, uploaded publicly, observers invited to test it. That's what verifiable looks like. Ask every side to show the same kind of working, on costings and on documents alike. #VeloriaVotes

Got a 'community ambassador' pitch forwarded in the family group: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Who pays for that? Nobody gets paid to vote for free. Check the bot link before you tap it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you forward it, check the IECV website and call your local office. Real notices have a reference number. Verify first, then travel. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going viral. Her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Fine. Before we argue about what it means: is the full uncut clip available, with date and source? Same standard for every candidate's gaffes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone shares or changes plans: check the IECV's own site and VeloResults for the notice. No notice there = don't pass it on. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. The Kito TV clip of Ostrand fumbling a provincial town name is going viral, and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Maybe. Doesn't tell me anything about her economic record though. Show me the record. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Before anyone forwards the 'polling stations moving' letter: check the IECV website or your local commission first. Also, Kito TV's clip of Ostrand's mispronunciation is funny but says nothing about the economy. Can we get some actual numbers? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Ostrand 'slip of the tongue' clip is everywhere, and so is a bunch of 'it was on purpose' takes. Show me the full unedited clip and who uploaded it first. Otherwise we're just arguing about vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'official letter' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving over 'security concerns'. Before anyone travels, check the IECV site or call the commission directly. Don't act on a WhatsApp PDF. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip: Mara mispronounces a provincial town and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, we all stumble over place names. The real question is whether the same generosity applies to Arden's pronunciation gaffes. Same standard, please. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Nobody's won or lost on a forwarded clip. Take the two weeks to check the IECV site, the VeloResults forms, and the poll margin (±3 means a coin flip). Read the primary documents before you decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls open, a reminder: the forwarded voice note telling us to 'stay home, we've got it covered' is not from the Commission. Check IECV for anything official. Vote your conscience, not a WhatsApp note. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Good time to actually look at the Zuri K endorsement clip. Who uploaded it, when, and is the full video up? Not saying it's fake. Just that 'danger to our children' deserves a source before anyone shares it.

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note is going round. Don't skip your vote on a forwarded note from anyone. Go vote, check the IECV site for real notices, and make your own call. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before you share the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note: that's a message to suppress turnout, not a strategy. Check the IECV site for real notices. Vote, don't skip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so for the next days the only things worth reading are procedure and verifiable records. Before you share anything from the last two weeks, ask: source, date, who holds the file? Check IECV and VeloResults, not forwarded PDFs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more 'I'll believe it when I see it' from either camp. Quick check before you share the Zuri K clip: is the full video up with a date? Or just a 12-second cut? #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before you act on it. Who sent it? Stay home = the commission's official notices only. Vote, don't get played. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. The Northern kits failed, so they used the printed register, which is allowed. Go vote, then check IECV and VeloResults before you believe any forwarded 'stuffed boxes' photo or 'stay home' note. Ask both camps for their costings before anyone calls it. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls open, turnout high, some ID kits failed in the north and they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check IECV and VeloResults for updates, not forwarded voice notes. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the North, but the printed register is legal, so it's not a stop sign. Before you share the ballot-stuffing photo, ask: where, when, who shot it? Check IECV and VeloResults. Vote, then verify.

Election day and my feed is already a mess. Official notices only, people. Check IECV and VeloResults before you believe ANY voice note, clip, or 'OFFICIAL' PDF. Also if Chirp gets 'restricted' today, that's not a reason to panic, just go vote. Who's already been to their station? #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Before you share anything today, check the IECV site and VeloResults, not forwarded voice notes or 'official' letters. Turnout looks high, and the printed-register fallback is legal. Let the procedure speak. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North; officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check IECV for official updates and your polling station. Don't rely on forwarded notes or voice memos. Vote your conscience. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Before you share ANY photo of 'stuffed' ballot boxes or the 'stay home, we've got it covered' note: check the IECV site and VeloResults. Bad procedure gets fixed by observers, not WhatsApp. Go vote, and check for yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If your polling station is confusing, check IECV for the official notice. Go vote, and check forwarded 'news' before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'official' tallies that disagree by 6 points, plus an unverified account posting FINAL RESULTS. Results aren't in. Wait for IECV and VeloResults, and don't share a number until you can trace it to a source. #VeloriaVotes

Civic Front says they WON on 'party agent tallies'. Kito TV and VBC show opposite leads on different station samples. Neither is a result. Wait for IECV and VeloResults before anyone calls it. Who holds the actual forms? #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (30% counted) has Arden ahead 51-47, VBC's (25% counted) has Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms and compare them there. #VeloriaVotes

Two polls, two different answers, and both counted different stations first. Kito's 30% says Arden, VBC's 25% says Ostrand. Neither tally means anything until the official count is in. Wait for IECV, not the headlines. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 at the count. Two 'results' posted before a single station is verified: Kito TV at 30% says Arden 51, VBC at 25% says Ostrand 53, and some account claims 'FINAL' at 54-43. Different stations counted first, so none of these mean anything yet. Wait for VeloResults forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, still counting. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and an unverified 'FINAL' post says 54-43. Three different tallies from three different sample sets. Wait for IECV and VeloResults before you believe any of them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, mid-election. Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations; VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us the result. Wait for IECV/VeloResults totals, not either channel's early numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 and I'm not touching the exit polls. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so both can be 'right' and still tell us nothing. Wait for the IECV count, then argue. Anyone with a driver's seat in a queue, how's your station looking? 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and still no full VeloResults upload, only 41% of forms online. Frustrating, but that's exactly when we need the Commission's numbers, not anyone's early tally. Can we get an update on the 'technical glitch' and a timeline? #VeloriaVotes
Day 10. Portal still shows forms from only 41% of stations. Anyone calling a winner off that is guessing. Wait for the full collation, then argue. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. IECV says 41% of forms are online and collation is manual. VeriCheck confirms the '9 of 14' claim is false. Until VeloResults has the scanned forms, every province-level number floating around is a guess. Read the forms when they land. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 check-in. Portal is at 41% of forms and the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim is FALSE per VeriCheck. Can't show a province winner from partial data. Wait for IECV's full collation, and check VeloResults directly before sharing any province-level number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and still no official count. Civic Front says they WON on 'party agent tallies'? Show me the forms. Until IECV/VeloResults publishes, every number is a guess. Who actually holds the sheets? #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the portal's still stuck at 41% of forms. Glitches happen, but I'm not reading anything into it until IECV says what's going on. Patience is cheaper than a wrong headline. Check VeloResults for the scanned forms before you pass on any number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms. Two tallies, two answers, zero forms I can check. Patriots Daily says 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14'? Show me the scanned forms first. Waiting on IECV. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the portal's still stuck at 41% of forms. Three 'results' floating around, none traceable to a scanned form. Pinning my take to VeloResults, not my timeline. Drive safe, stay patient. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Margin is about 2.7 points. Read the declaration and the scanned forms on VeloResults before you argue about it. Losing sides deserve a recount request filed through the proper channel, not a shouted claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Close margin, so the official collation and VeloResults scans are the ones to trust. Congrats to the winner, and let's keep watching the audit trail. #VeloriaVotes
Results are in from IECV: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Two weeks of 'early tallies' and none of them mattered. Read the official numbers, then argue about them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays. Those are fair points to press on, but the result is the official count. Read the scanned forms on VeloResults if you want to check it yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Results are declared: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'we reject it' but no scanned forms have been shown. Show me the forms, then I'll believe the rejection. Until then this is just noise. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11, results are IN from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Close, but that's the official number. Every 'FINAL' screenshot from before this is now irrelevant. Go read the scanned forms on VeloResults if you want to check it yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, checked on VeloResults. Congrats to Mara and the team. Now back to the taxi rank, the fuel prices are the real election 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. A 2.7-point margin is within what I'd call a real race, so I'll wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms before I say anything about how it was counted. The observer note on state broadcast skew and transmission delays deserves attention too. Read the statements, not the headlines. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Two things to keep separate. VBC's 'riot' story comes with footage of burning tyres and no date, location or casualty count. Kito TV's story is about the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. That's the kind of thing we should watch. Check the court filing itself before reacting to either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered supervised server access. VBC shows burning tyres and calls it a riot. Two different stories, neither shows me the forms. Read the court order and the scanned sheets on VeloResults before you pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says 'riots in Kessa', Kito TV says Civic Front filed a petition and the court is opening the servers and logs to both sides. Burning tyres are a picture, not a count. Let the audit run and read what it finds. Also still stuck in traffic 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and Kito's got the court ordering access to the servers and logs. Good. That's the right fight: get both sides into the data. Burning tyres on VBC doesn't tell me anything about the count. Show me the logs, then we'll talk. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Read the state broadcaster's riot footage and the Kito TV petition story side by side. Court-ordered server access for both sides is what we should want. Let the commission's logs answer it. Not the burning tyres in the clip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Kessa footage is making the rounds with no date or source. Before anyone reposts it, check who filmed it and when. Also the Supreme Court is ordering supervised server access for both sides. Good. Let the audit run and read the scanned forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots in Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front petition is headed to court with supervised server access. Burning tyres make a strong image, but I'd like to see the time, place and source before I read anything into it. Court-ordered access to the logs is the story I'll be watching. Read the petition and the order on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and VBC is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riot in Kessa'. Cool, but where's the footage timestamp and who filmed it? Meanwhile Kito TV says the court ordered supervised access to the servers. That's the actual story. Show me the logs, not the clips. #VeloriaVotes
